education.quote: have completed academic and supervised field work requirements of an accredited educational program in occupational therapy

national_exam.value: Pass the NBCOT certification exam, with the passing score report sent to the Board by NBCOT directly.
national_exam.quote: This must be sent by NBCOT directly to the Board. Contact NBCOT to arrange that this be sent to the Board.

state_exam.value: Required: a 20-question, open-book online Texas Jurisprudence Exam (JP) on the OT Act and Rules. There is no fee and it can be retaken until passed.
state_exam.quote: The Board requires a 20-question, open-book online Jurisprudence Exam (JP) based on the OT Rules and OT Practice Act

background_check.value: Fingerprinting for a state and national criminal history check is required before a license is issued, using the agency's service code.
background_check.quote: Please see the announcement on the homepage to access the fingerprinting instructions. Fingerprinting is a required item for license issuance.

application_fee.value: $140 for an OT ($100 for an OTA), and it is non-refundable. A temporary license costs an extra $70 for an OT.
application_fee.quote: The fee for an OT Application is $140.00; the fee for an OTA Application is $100.00.

endorsement.value: OTs who passed NBCOT and hold a current license in another U.S. state or territory apply by endorsement. Applicants from the military or from a non-licensing jurisdiction can instead show two years of OT work just before applying. They submit the same items as exam applicants (application, fee, photo, fingerprints, NBCOT score report, JP exam), plus license verification for any license the Board cannot check online.
endorsement.quote: The applicant must submit a verification of license for any of the occupational therapy licenses (past and current) that the Board cannot verify, including disciplinary action.

temporary_or_provisional.value: A temporary license is available only to applicants by exam who are taking the NBCOT exam for the first time. It requires a separate application, a $70 fee for an OT, NBCOT eligibility documents and on-premises supervision by an OT with a regular license. It becomes void if the applicant fails the exam or does not take it, and it lasts no longer than 180 days.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: A temporary license is only available to an applicant for licensure by examination who is taking the NBCOT exam for the first time.

renewal.value: OT licenses are renewed every two years, by the end of the licensee's birth month. Renewal can start up to three months before expiration.
renewal.quote: Licensees are required to renew their licenses every two years by the end of their birth month.

continuing_education.value: 24 contact hours of CE per two-year renewal period. These must include a human trafficking prevention course approved by the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC). The OT jurisprudence exam is also retaken at each renewal.
continuing_education.quote: Texas OT and OTA licensees are required to complete 24 contact hours of continuing education each renewal period in order to maintain licensure

apply_url.value: Apply online through the ECPTOTE Online Licensing System after creating an account. A paper application is also available.
apply_url.quote: To apply online, you will need to create an account in the new Online Licensing System.

board.value: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
board.quote: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists PO Box 12157 Austin, TX 78711

education.value: A master's degree or higher with a major in communicative sciences or disorders, from a program accredited by a nationally recognized accreditor approved by TDLR. Graduates of foreign programs need an evaluation from an ASHA-approved service. The clinical practicum must include 400 clock hours for degrees earned since 2005.
education.quote: which shows the applicant possesses a minimum of a master's degree with a major in one of the areas of communicative sciences or disorders

national_exam.value: Pass the national Praxis exam in speech-language pathology, given by ETS. ASHA CCC holders are exempt from submitting Praxis scores. TDLR does not state a passing score.
national_exam.quote: Applicants must pass both the national Praxis Exam as well as the Texas Jurisprudence Examination.

state_exam.value: Required: the Texas Speech-Language Pathologist and Audiologist Jurisprudence Examination. Proof of completion goes in with the application, and the certificate can be no more than 12 months old.
state_exam.quote: All applicants for initial licensure must submit proof of completing the jurisprudence examination at the time they submit their Texas Speech-Language Pathologist and Audiologist License Application.

background_check.value: All new applicants submit fingerprints for a national criminal history check. TDLR emails scheduling instructions after it receives the application.
background_check.quote: All new applicants must submit fingerprints for a national criminal history record review.

application_fee.value: $150 application fee, which includes the two-year initial license.
application_fee.quote: submit the online application along with the $150 application fee (includes two-year initial license) and required documents.

endorsement.value: TDLR has no separate endorsement route: SLPs licensed elsewhere apply for the standard license. TDLR may waive the internship and Praxis requirements for anyone who holds or has held the ASHA CCC. The jurisprudence exam, fingerprints and the $150 fee still apply.
endorsement.quote: The department may waive the internship and written examination (Praxis) requirements for applicants who currently hold or have previously held the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC)

temporary_or_provisional.value: Clinical fellows need an Intern in Speech-Language Pathology license ($75, valid one year) to complete the 36-week, 1,260-hour supervised internship in Texas under a TDLR-approved supervisor. ASHA CF approval alone does not allow practice. Interns upgrade to a full license after finishing the internship and passing the Praxis.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: In order to complete the required 36-week internship in Texas, an Intern in Speech-Language Pathology license is required.

renewal.value: SLP licenses last two years (intern licenses one year). The renewal fee is $100, and licenses can be renewed starting 60 days before expiration.
renewal.quote: All licenses are issued licenses for 2 years, except for Intern licenses, which are valid for one year.

continuing_education.value: 20 clock hours of CE per renewal period, including 2 hours of ethics, from ASHA, TSHA, AAA or TAA approved providers. An HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course is also required to renew.
continuing_education.quote: Speech-language pathologists are required to obtain 20 clock hours of continuing education (2 continuing education units), with 2 clock hours (0.2 continuing education units) in ethics.

compact.value: Texas is not a member of the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact (ASLP-IC), so out-of-state SLPs need a full Texas license.
compact.quote: ASLP-IC: Texas is not a member state of the Audiology

apply_url.value: Apply online through the TDLR Online Licensing System; the TDLR page linked here has the portal link.
apply_url.quote: To apply for a new speech-language pathology license, submit the online application along with the $150 application fee

board.value: Physical and Occupational Therapy Licensing Board
board.quote: There is created the Physical and Occupational Therapy Licensing Board, consisting of: (a) three licensed physical therapists

education.value: Applicants must submit proof of graduation from a professional physical therapist education program accredited by a recognized accreditation agency.
education.quote: submit proof of graduation from a professional physical therapist education program that is accredited by a recognized accreditation agency

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the NPTE, registering directly with FSBPT; graduates of a CAPTE-accredited school may register once they graduate or are within 90 days of graduation.
national_exam.quote: Candidates may register for the NPTE-PT or the NPTE-PTA directly with FSBPT if they are a graduate of, or within 90 days of graduation, of a CAPTE accredited school.

background_check.value: Applicants must submit fingerprint cards for a criminal background check; missing fingerprints are the most common cause of delays or denial.
background_check.quote: This license type requires applicants to submit fingerprints. The lack of fingerprint cards is the #1 reason for significant delays or denial of an application.

endorsement.value: Physical therapists licensed in a jurisdiction Utah deems equivalent may apply by endorsement if they have held that license for at least one year and it is active and in good standing.
endorsement.quote: To apply to Utah using one of the licenses deemed equivalent (jurisdictions in green on the above map), you must have held the license type indicated on the map for at least one year.

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants registered for the NPTE may hold a temporary license to practice under direct on-site supervision of a licensed physical therapist; it is valid for 6 months from issuance or until the exam is failed twice, and cannot be extended.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: A temporary license is valid for 6 months from the date of issuance or upon failing the required exam twice.

renewal.value: Physical therapist licenses expire on May 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal.quote: License expires on May 31 of odd years.

continuing_education.value: Physical therapists must complete at least 40 contact hours of continuing education per renewal, at least 2 hours of which must be in ethics.
continuing_education.quote: PTAs: Complete at least 20 contact hours. At least 2 hours of the total must be in topics relating to ethics.

compact.value: Utah participates in the Physical Therapy Compact, and physical therapists and assistants can hold a compact privilege to practice in Utah.
compact.quote: If you want to verify if a Physical Therapist or Physical Therapist Assistant has a privilege to practice in Utah under the compact, browse to:

processing_time.value: The typical processing time for a complete application is 21 days.
processing_time.quote: The typical processing time frame for a complete application is 21 days.

apply_url.value: Applicants apply online or with a paper application through the Utah Division of Professional Licensing physical therapist license page.
apply_url.quote: If you are currently licensed as the equivalent of a Physical Therapist in another state, territory, or district of the United States you may qualify for licensure by endorsement.

board.value: Physical and Occupational Therapy Licensing Board

board.value: Washington Board of Hearing and Speech
board.quote: The Board of Hearing and Speech governs the three separate professions: Hearing aid specialist, audiology, and speech language pathology.

education.value: Applicants must complete a master's degree program that includes clinical practicum experience, plus postgraduate professional work experience of at least 36 weeks full time or the part-time equivalent.
education.quote: Applicants for speech-language pathologist licenses must provide proof of successfully completing a master's degree program that includes clinical practicum experience.

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the nationally recognized speech-language pathology examination, the Praxis, with verification sent directly from or verified with the examination agency.
national_exam.quote: Speech-language pathologist applicants must pass the national recognized speech-language pathology examination, the PRAXIS examination.

state_exam.value: Speech-language pathologists must take and pass the board-approved jurisprudence examination within the first year of licensure; it counts as one hour of continuing education.
state_exam.quote: A credential holder must take and pass the jurisprudence examination approved by the board within the first year of licensure.

background_check.value: A background check is processed for every applicant, and the Department of Health may require a fingerprint-based check through the Washington State Patrol and the FBI.
background_check.quote: A background check is processed for every applicant. DOH may need to obtain a fingerprint-based background check with the Washington State Patrol and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

application_fee.value: The speech-language pathologist license application and initial license fee is $191, which includes the $16 University of Washington HEALWA fee.
application_fee.quote: License application and initial license - $191* Interim permit and application - $305 Active license renewal - $61*

endorsement.value: Applicants currently licensed for at least the immediately preceding two years in a state with substantially equivalent standards qualify for licensure by endorsement; holders of ASHA's Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) may also qualify.
endorsement.quote: An applicant that is currently licensed, and has been licensed for at least the immediately preceding two years in a state or jurisdiction with substantially equivalent standards to Washington

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants who have completed the academic coursework and clinical practicum and have an approved supervisor may receive an interim permit, which expires one year from issuance and may be extended by the board up to an additional twenty-four months.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: The interim permit expires one year from the date it is issued.

renewal.value: Speech-language pathologists must renew their licenses every year on or before their birthday and pay the appropriate fee.
renewal.quote: Speech-Language Pathologists must renew their licenses every year on or before their birthday. They're required to submit the appropriate fee.

continuing_education.value: Speech-language pathologists must complete at least 30 hours of continuing education every three years, including at least one hour of infection control, at least 2 hours of health equity training, one hour from passing the jurisprudence exam, and at least 25 hours on profession-specific skills.
continuing_education.quote: Audiologists, hearing aid specialists, speech-language pathologists, and speech-language pathology assistants must complete a minimum of 30 hours of continuing education every three years within the following topics:

compact.value: Washington joined the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact (ASLP-IC) on 07/23/2023.
compact.quote: Washington state joined the Audiologist Speech-Language Pathologist Interstate Compact (ASLP-IC) on 07/23/2023.

processing_time.value: The Department of Health says processing timelines can range from a few days to a few weeks, depending on factors such as the type of application and whether it needs board approval.
processing_time.quote: Timelines can range from a few days to a few weeks, depending upon many factors such as the type of application and whether it requires board or commission approval.

apply_url.value: Applicants can apply online or on paper through the Department of Health's speech-language pathologist application page.
apply_url.quote: Once you have completed the process, you will find your pending credential number on the Provider Credential Search

board.value: West Virginia Board of Physical Therapy
board.quote: is a state regulatory board created by the WV Legislature to regulate the practice of physical therapy and athletic training

education.value: Applicants must hold a bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in physical therapy from a CAPTE-accredited program.
education.quote: To be eligible for a license to practice, you must have a bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in physical therapy from a CAPTE accredited program.

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the National Physical Therapy Exam (NPTE); the board allows qualified applicants to take the NPTE within 90 days of graduation.
national_exam.quote: You must be planning to take the National Physical Therapy Exam, or have already taken the exam and successfully passed.

background_check.value: Applicants for an initial license must submit fingerprints for a state and national criminal history record check.
background_check.quote: shall require an applicant, including physical therapists and physical therapy assistants, as a condition of eligibility for initial license to submit to a state and national criminal history record check

application_fee.value: Physical therapist applicants pay a $25 application fee and a $220 license fee.
application_fee.quote: 2.2.1. Physical Therapist Application $25 2.2.2. Physical Therapist License $220

endorsement.value: Physical therapists already licensed in another state who have taken the NPTE apply by endorsement: they must have FSBPT transfer their NPTE score report, have their school send a conferred transcript, have license verifications sent from every jurisdiction where they have held a license, and complete a criminal history record check.
endorsement.quote: This application is for individuals who are currently licensed in another state and wish to obtain a license to practice in West Virginia through endorsement.

temporary_or_provisional.value: Graduates applying to take the NPTE may request a temporary permit if a conferred transcript is on file and they have secured employment; the permit is valid for 90 days and is automatically revoked if they fail the NPTE.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: The temporary permit is valid for 90 days.

renewal.value: Licenses are renewed every two years; renewal season runs from October 1 to December 31 of the year the license expires, with no grace period, and unrenewed licenses become delinquent.
renewal.quote: Renewals begin October 1 and end December 31 in the year your license is due to expire.

continuing_education.value: Licensees must complete 24 hours of board-approved continuing education within each 2-year licensing period and upload proof of it before they can renew.
continuing_education.quote: All licensees desiring to remain active and in good standing must complete 24 hours of WV board approved CE courses within the 2 year licensing period.

compact.value: West Virginia has been an active PT Compact member state since March 10, 2020; West Virginia-domiciled licensees can obtain privileges to practice in other compact states, and out-of-state licensees can purchase a privilege to practice in West Virginia through ptcompact.org.
compact.quote: As of Tuesday March 10, 2020 West Virginia became an active member state in the PT Compact.

processing_time.value: The board says overall timelines for initial applications cannot be determined in advance, but once all requirements are received a license is issued within one to two business days.
processing_time.quote: Once all requirements are received, a license is issued/reinstated within one to two business days, and you will receive an email.

apply_url.value: Applicants apply online through the board's Application Portal, linked from the board's Exam Applications page (licensed applicants from other states use the Endorsement Applications page).
apply_url.quote: This application is for individuals applying to take the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE) who do not wish to obtain a temporary permit.

board.value: West Virginia Board of Occupational Therapy
board.quote: The WV Board of Occupational Therapy regulates and licenses persons providing Occupational Therapy services to the general public of WV.

education.value: Applicants must complete the academic requirements of an ACOTE-accredited occupational therapy program and the supervised fieldwork experience required by that program.
education.quote: Have successfully completed the academic requirements of an educational program for Occupational Therapists or Occupational Therapy Assistants that is accredited by the American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE)

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass a board-approved examination, which may be administered by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT) or another nationally recognized credentialing body approved by the board.
national_exam.quote: The examination may be administered by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy, Inc. (NBCOT) or another nationally recognized credentialing body as approved by the board.

background_check.value: An FBI criminal background check is not required to obtain a West Virginia OT license; it is required only for those who want to purchase OT Compact privileges in other member states.
background_check.quote: THE FBI CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECK IS NOT REQUIRED TO OBTAIN A LICENSE TO PRACTICE IN WV.

application_fee.value: The initial licensure fee for an occupational therapist is $75.
application_fee.quote: Initial licensure fees for a WV license are $75 for OT and $50 for OTA.

endorsement.value: The board may license an applicant who holds a current OT license in another jurisdiction whose licensing standards the board considers equivalent to West Virginia's, provided the applicant also meets the state's licensing qualifications.
endorsement.quote: The board may issue a license to practice to any applicant who presents proof of current licensure as an occupational therapist or an occupational therapy assistant in another jurisdiction

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants who have completed the education and fieldwork requirements may receive a limited permit to practice under the direct close supervision of a licensed occupational therapist; it is not renewable, is valid for ninety days, and expires immediately if the holder fails the exam.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: A limited permit is not renewable, and is valid for ninety days: Provided, That the limited permit expires immediately if the holder receives notification of a failing score on the examination.

renewal.value: Licenses are renewed every two years online through Certemy, and the renewal must be submitted by the license expiration date to avoid a $100 late fee.
renewal.quote: It must be submitted by the expiration date to avoid assessment of $100 late fee.

continuing_education.value: Licensees must complete at least 24 contact hours of continuing education in the 2 years before renewal; those first licensed during the first twelve months of a 24 month reporting period need 12 contact hours.
continuing_education.quote: Subsequent renewals require a minimum of 24 contact hours during the 2 year period preceding the license renewal date.

compact.value: West Virginia participates in the OT Compact: a practitioner whose home state is an active compact member can purchase a privilege to practice in West Virginia for a $75 Commission fee plus a $50 West Virginia fee, $125 in total.
compact.quote: Fees to purchase a privilege to practice include a $75 fee paid to the OT Compact Commission plus a WV state fee of $50, for a total of $125 each time purchased.

apply_url.value: Applicants apply online through Certemy, the board's licensing system, by choosing an application type on the board's New Applicants pages.
apply_url.quote: Applications are completed online through Certemy, our licensing management software provider, and include a number of steps to be completed and submitted for verification and approval.

board.value: West Virginia Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology
board.quote: The mission of the West Virginia Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology is to protect consumers by ensuring that all licensed practitioners meet or exceed education standards

education.value: Applicants must hold at least a master's degree or equivalent in speech-language pathology with coursework approved by the Council of Academic Accreditation (CAA), and must also complete supervised clinical practicum and a postgraduate professional experience.
education.quote: Possess at least a master’s degree or equivalent in Speech-Language Pathology that consists of coursework approved by the Council of Academic Accreditation (CAA).

national_exam.value: Applicants must obtain a passing score on the national examination in speech-language pathology; the board recognizes only the Educational Testing Service (ETS) specialty area examinations.
national_exam.quote: Obtain a passing score on the national examination in the area of Speech-Language Pathology. The Board recognizes only the Educational Testing Service’s (ETS) specialty area examinations

state_exam.value: Applicants must pass the board's jurisprudence examination and submit the score with the license application.
state_exam.quote: Pass the jurisprudence examination developed by the Board. The examination score shall be submitted with the application for licensure, fees and other required documents.

background_check.value: The board may require state and national criminal history record checks to issue licenses, and it requires a fingerprint-based state and national check of anyone applying for an initial compact privilege to practice under the ASLP-IC.
background_check.quote: The West Virginia Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology may require state and national criminal history record checks for the purpose of issuing licenses.

application_fee.value: Applicants pay a non-refundable $100 application fee plus a license fee of $200 when applying January through June of the first (odd) year of the licensing period, with pro-rated license fees of $150, $100 or $50 later in the cycle.
application_fee.quote: License, Interstate Telepractice Registration and Provisional license application fee (non-refundable) - $100

endorsement.value: The board waives the national exam requirement for applicants who hold a current license in a state with substantially equivalent standards or who hold ASHA's Certificate of Clinical Competence, and such applicants may practice while their application is pending.
endorsement.quote: The board shall waive the national examination requirements in speech-language pathology and/or audiology for an applicant who either:

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants completing the postgraduate professional experience (clinical fellowship year) practice under a provisional license, which is issued for one year and can be renewed for one additional year after 10 hours of board-approved continuing education.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: The provisional license is renewable for one additional year upon proof of the completion of a minimum of 10 hours of Board approved continuing education

renewal.value: Licenses other than provisional licenses expire every two years on December 31 of even-numbered years; renewal requires the renewal fee, a renewal application and board-approved continuing education.
renewal.quote: All licenses, except provisional licenses and assistants’ registrations, expire biennially on the 31st day of December.

continuing_education.value: Licensees must complete at least 20 clock hours of continuing education every two-year licensure period, including one clock hour of approved ethics per year (two hours total).
continuing_education.quote: A professional licensee shall obtain a minimum of 20 clock hours of continuing education during every two-year licensure period.

compact.value: West Virginia is an ASLP-IC member state, and registration for compact privileges to practice is open for licensed practitioners in West Virginia through CompactConnect.
compact.quote: for compact privileges to practice is open for licensed practitioners in Louisiana, Ohio, Tennessee, and West Virginia.

apply_url.value: Applicants submit the board's Initial License Application for Speech-Language Pathology & Audiology, a paper form posted on the board's Forms page.
apply_url.quote: Have you ever been licensed as a SLP or an AUD in West Virginia?

board.value: Wisconsin Physical Therapy Examining Board
board.quote: Learn about the formation and governing rules of the Wisconsin Physical Therapy Examining Board.

education.value: Applicants must be enrolled in or a graduate of a physical therapist educational program approved by the board (CAPTE); graduates of non-approved or foreign programs must obtain an educational equivalency evaluation at their own expense.
education.quote: Education requirement – applicant should be enrolled in or a graduate of a Physical Therapist educational program approved by the board, CAPTE (Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education).

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE), registering and paying directly with the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT).
national_exam.quote: You must register directly with and pay the required fee(s) to the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT) to take the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE).

state_exam.value: Applicants must pass an open-book exam on the Wisconsin Statutes and Administrative Code; the passing score for physical therapists is 85%.
state_exam.quote: The passing score for Physical Therapist is 85%.

background_check.value: Applicants must submit Form 2687, an authorization for release of FBI information, which is required for the criminal background check.
background_check.quote: Form 2687 – Authorization for Release of FBI Information Form (Race/Ethnicity/Sex information and signature and signature date are required for criminal background check.)

application_fee.value: The initial license fee for a physical therapist is $68, and the renewal fee is $68.
application_fee.quote: Physical Therapist Individual $68 $68 02/28/Odd 19 Physical Therapist Assistant Individual $68

endorsement.value: Physical therapists licensed in another U.S. jurisdiction who have already passed the NPTE may apply by endorsement, with license verification sent directly from the other state and a passing score on the Wisconsin statutes and rules exam.
endorsement.quote: The Endorsement method is for a Physical Therapist applicant licensed in another jurisdiction/state as a Physical Therapist and has not previously held a Wisconsin Physical Therapist license.

temporary_or_provisional.value: A temporary license lets initial applicants who have registered for the NPTE and are awaiting results practice as physical therapists under supervision; the supervisor uploads Form 3197 to the application.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: The Temporary License method is for a Physical Therapist applicant to practice as a Physical Therapist under supervision. The applicant has already submitted a Physical Therapist Initial Application and still needs to pass the NPTE.

renewal.value: Physical therapist licenses renew every two years; the reporting period runs from March 1 of an odd-numbered year through February 28 of the next odd-numbered year.
renewal.quote: March 1 of an odd-numbered year through February 28 of the next odd-numbered year

continuing_education.value: Physical therapists must complete at least 30 contact hours of approved continuing education each biennial (2-year) period, including at least 4 contact hours in ethics and jurisprudence.
continuing_education.quote: Physical therapists are required to complete at least 30 contact hours of approved continuing education during each biennial (2 year) registration period. In addition, at least 4 contact hours of the 30 must be in ethics and jurisprudence.

compact.value: Wisconsin participates in the PT Compact: physical therapists licensed in another compact member state can obtain compact privileges in Wisconsin after passing the Wisconsin statutes and rules exam (85% or higher) and purchasing privileges through the PT Compact.
compact.quote: The Compact Privileges method is for applicants seeking Compact Privileges in Wisconsin. A passing score on the Wisconsin Statutes and Rules exam is required.

processing_time.value: DSPS states that application materials are reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team, though some licenses take longer due to complexity.
processing_time.quote: Your materials will be reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team.

apply_url.value: Applications are submitted online through the DSPS LicensE portal (license.wi.gov).
apply_url.quote: Go to license.wi.gov to apply for a credential or license.

board.value: Wisconsin Occupational Therapists Affiliated Credentialing Board
board.quote: View information about the formation and governing rules of the Wisconsin Occupational Therapists Affiliated Credentialing Board.

education.value: Applicants must successfully complete an accredited occupational therapy educational program and be certified by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT).
education.quote: Successfully complete an accredited occupational therapy educational program. Receive certification by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT).

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the NBCOT Occupational Therapist Registered (OTR) certification exam; they may apply before passing it but must pass to receive the license.
national_exam.quote: You may apply before passing the exam, but you must pass the exam to receive the credential.

state_exam.value: Applicants must pass an open-book examination on the Wisconsin Statutes and Administrative Code with a score of 88% or higher.
state_exam.quote: Pass the open-book examination on the Wisconsin Statutes and Administrative Code with a score of 88% or higher.

background_check.value: An FBI background check is required for occupational therapists seeking Home State Approval to participate in the OT Compact; instructions are sent after the application is submitted.
background_check.quote: An FBI Background Check is required for participation in the Compact. Instructions will be sent on how to complete upon submission of your application.

application_fee.value: The initial license fee for an occupational therapist is $75, and the renewal fee is $75.
application_fee.quote: Occupational Therapist Individual $75 $75 05/31/Odd 27 Occupational Therapist Assistant Individual $75

endorsement.value: Occupational therapists with a current, active OT credential from another U.S. state or territory may apply by reciprocity, subject to legal review of that state, and must pass the Wisconsin open-book statutes and rules exam.
endorsement.quote: You must have a current, active occupational therapist (OT) credential issued by another state or territory of the United States.

temporary_or_provisional.value: A temporary permit is available to initial applicants who are scheduled to take, or awaiting results of, the NBCOT OTR exam; holders must consult with an occupational therapist at least monthly, and the permit is issued for 6 months and may not be renewed.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: Your temporary license is issued for 6 months and may not be renewed.

renewal.value: Occupational therapist licenses renew every two years; the reporting period runs from June 1 of an odd-numbered year through May 31 of the next odd-numbered year.
renewal.quote: June 1 of an odd-numbered year through May 31 of the next odd-numbered year

continuing_education.value: Occupational therapists must complete 24 continuing education points every two years, where 1 point equals 1 hour; CE is not required before the first renewal.
continuing_education.quote: To renew your Wisconsin occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant license, you must complete 24 continuing education points every two years.

compact.value: Wisconsin participates in the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact: OTs with Home State Approval from another compact state can apply for a privilege to practice in Wisconsin, and Wisconsin licensees can apply for Home State Approval.
compact.quote: For applicants who have already been granted Home State Approval to participate in the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact (OTLC) by another state, and wish to gain Privilege to Practice in Wisconsin.

processing_time.value: DSPS states that application materials are reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team, though some licenses take longer due to complexity.
processing_time.quote: Your materials will be reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team.

apply_url.value: Applications are submitted online through the DSPS LicensE portal (license.wi.gov).
apply_url.quote: Go to license.wi.gov to apply for a credential or license.

board.value: Wisconsin Hearing and Speech Examining Board
board.quote: The members of the Hearing and Speech Examining Board are appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Legislature to serve 4-year terms.

education.value: Applicants must have completed a supervised clinical practicum and received a master's degree in speech-language pathology from a board-approved college or university, or substantially equivalent education or training.
education.quote: Completed a supervised clinical practicum and received a master’s degree in speech-language pathology from a college or university approved by the board.

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the Praxis exam, with official scores sent to DSPS directly by the testing company; scores submitted by applicants are not accepted.
national_exam.quote: Applicants are required to take and pass the Praxis exam for this application method. Please refer to the testing company for details on how to take this exam and have your official score report sent to DSPS.

background_check.value: Applicants must provide evidence satisfactory to the board that they do not have a conviction record.
background_check.quote: Stats., evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant does not have a conviction record.

application_fee.value: The initial license fee for a speech-language pathologist is $75, and the renewal fee is $75.
application_fee.quote: Speech-Language Pathology Individual $75 $75 01/31/Odd 450 SUA - Analytical Laboratory Organization $25

endorsement.value: Applicants holding at least one full, active speech-language pathologist license in another state may apply by reciprocity, with license verifications sent directly from every jurisdiction where they hold or held a license.
endorsement.quote: This page is the subsite for applicants who hold at least one full, active speech-language pathologist license in another state.

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants must obtain a temporary license before beginning a postgraduate clinical fellowship, practicing under a licensed or compact-privilege-holding SLP; it is valid for 18 months and may be renewed once by the board.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: A temporary license to practice speech-language pathology is valid for 18 months. A temporary license may be renewed once by the board.

renewal.value: Speech-language pathologist licenses must be renewed by January 31 of each odd-numbered year, even if the license was issued in the months just before that date.
renewal.quote: The required renewal date for the Speech-Language Pathologist credential is 01/31/ each odd-numbered year.

continuing_education.value: Speech-language pathologists must complete at least 20 hours of board-approved continuing education in each biennial renewal period, including at least 2 hours relating to ethics; new licensees need not report CE until their second renewal.
continuing_education.quote: in each biennial renewal period. Of the 20 required hours, at least 2 hours shall relate to ethics.

compact.value: Wisconsin rules provide for compact privileges for speech-language pathologists under the interstate compact; applicants must hold an unencumbered home state license in another compact state, complete the compact application process and pay the required fee.
compact.quote: Every applicant for compact privilege as a speech-language pathologist or audiologist shall meet all of the following requirements:

processing_time.value: DSPS states that application materials are reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team, though some licenses take longer due to complexity.
processing_time.quote: Your materials will be reviewed within approximately 10 days by a member of the credentialing team.

apply_url.value: Applications are submitted online through the DSPS LicensE portal (license.wi.gov).
apply_url.quote: Go to license.wi.gov to apply for a credential or license.

board.value: Wyoming Board of Physical Therapy
board.quote: The Board of Physical Therapy was created in 1961 to safeguard the health, safety and welfare of the citizens of Wyoming

education.value: Applicants must have official transcripts sent directly from the registrar showing graduation from a physical therapy program accredited by CAPTE (Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education).
education.quote: giving evidence of graduation from an accredited program approved by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE)

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE), administered through FSBPT; the Board makes applicants eligible to test once a complete application and documentation are received.
national_exam.quote: You must register for the NPTE. Upon receipt of a complete application and required documentation, the Wyoming Board of Physical Therapy will make you eligible to test.

state_exam.value: All applicants must pass Wyoming's open-book jurisprudence exam, which must be completed and submitted with the application.
state_exam.quote: Successful completion of the jurisprudence exam is required of all applicants. The examination is open book

background_check.value: Under Wyoming Statute 7-19-201(a)(xv), all PT applicants must submit fingerprint cards for a state and national criminal history check; background checks can take up to 6 weeks.
background_check.quote: In accordance with Wyoming Statute 7-19-201(a)(xv), all PT and PTA applicants must submit fingerprint cards for purposes of obtaining state and national criminal history record information.

application_fee.value: The PT application fee is $289, which is the $250 licensure fee plus the $39 background check fee, payable to the State of Wyoming by money order or cashier's check and non-refundable.
application_fee.quote: Physical Therapist Licensure and Background Check Fee $250.00 + $39.00 = $289.00

endorsement.value: PTs who have passed the NPTE and hold a current license in another jurisdiction may apply by endorsement; they need verification from every jurisdiction where they have been licensed and evidence of 15 hours of continuing competence credits within the last year.
endorsement.quote: If you have already passed the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE) and are currently licensed/certified to practice physical therapy in another jurisdiction you may apply for a license/certificate by endorsement.

renewal.value: PT licenses expire on October 1 of the year following issuance and are renewed by submitting a timely application, the required fee, and verification of continuing competence.
renewal.quote: All permanent licenses and certificates issued pursuant to this act shall expire on October 1 of the year next succeeding their issuance.

continuing_education.value: PTs must complete 30 continuing competency units for the cycle (October 2, 2024 to October 1, 2026 for the 2026 renewal), at least 15 of them Category A, and must also submit a passing jurisprudence exam.
continuing_education.quote: In addition to the thirty (30) continuing competency units, the jurisprudence exam must be submitted with a passing score.

compact.value: Wyoming is listed as a non-member of the PT Compact, so compact privileges cannot be used to practice in Wyoming and Wyoming does not issue them.
compact.quote: Non-Members (10) California Florida Hawaii Idaho Minnesota New Mexico New York Puerto Rico U.S. Virgin Islands Wyoming

processing_time.value: Background check reports can take 4-6 weeks; once the file is complete and the background report is received, application processing takes approximately 7-10 additional business days.
processing_time.quote: Background check reports can take 4-6 weeks. Once your file is determined to be complete and your background report has been received,

apply_url.value: PT and PTA applications by examination and by endorsement are posted on the board's Forms page; the board emails applicants to confirm receipt and list any missing information.
apply_url.quote: Once your application is received, you will receive an email from the Board's administrative office confirming receipt and providing you a summary of any missing information.

board.value: Wyoming Board of Occupational Therapy
board.quote: The Board of Occupational Therapy was created March 4, 1991 to safeguard the health, safety and welfare of the citizens of Wyoming

education.value: Applicants must complete the academic requirements in an occupational therapy program accredited by ACOTE (or a successor organization) and the program's supervised fieldwork.
education.quote: Has successfully completed the academic requirements in occupational therapy in an approved program that is accredited by the American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE)

national_exam.value: Applicants must pass the NBCOT Certification Examination for Occupational Therapist, Registered (OTR), or the current exam recognized by the board, and have the official score report sent to Wyoming.
national_exam.quote: The Certification Examination for Occupational Therapist, Registered (OTR) as administered by the NBCOT or the current examination recognized by the board.

state_exam.value: Wyoming has no state OT exam; the board relies solely on the NBCOT exam.
state_exam.quote: No, we rely solely on the NBCOT exam.

background_check.value: The board queries the National Practitioner Data Bank on new and renewal applications to check whether any state has reported an adverse action against the applicant.
background_check.quote: The Board queries the National Practitioner Data Bank when applicants and licensees submit new and renewal applications in order to determine whether any other state has reported an adverse action

application_fee.value: The application fee for a full OT license is $225, payable to the State of Wyoming.
application_fee.quote: FEES: Full Licensure: Please make the payment out to the “State of Wyoming” OT/OTR = $225.00

endorsement.value: OTs currently licensed in another jurisdiction apply by endorsement and must have official license verification sent from every state where they hold or have held a healthcare profession license.
endorsement.quote: You will need to request an official verification from any state you have held a healthcare profession license.

temporary_or_provisional.value: Endorsement applicants who hold a current license in another state may also request a temporary license, valid for 90 days after approval; the OT cost is $275 ($225 license plus $50 temporary).
temporary_or_provisional.quote: You must hold a current license in another state. Upon approval, Temporary Licenses are valid for 90 days.

renewal.value: OT licenses are renewed each year (the current form is the 2026-2027 renewal application); the OT renewal fee is $110 if returned on or before June 15, 2026, and $210 after that date.
renewal.quote: Return this completed application on or before June 15, 2026 to avoid a late fee. Amount due AFTER June 15, 2026:

continuing_education.value: Licensees must complete 24 hours of continuing education every two years; someone first licensed in an odd-numbered year needs only 12 hours by the first even-numbered year.
continuing_education.quote: You are required to complete twenty-four (24) hours of CE every two years.

compact.value: Wyoming's Board of Occupational Therapy is a member of the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact.
compact.quote: Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact - The Wyoming Board is a member of the OT Compact. To learn more, go to the Compact page.

processing_time.value: The board states that processing time for all applications is 10-15 business days once a complete application is received.
processing_time.quote: Processing time for all applications is 10-15 business days, once a complete application is received.

apply_url.value: OT applications (by examination, by endorsement, limited license, and re-entry) are posted on the board's Applications page to download or print and complete.
apply_url.quote: Download the document from the File menu or print and complete the forms below.

board.value: Wyoming State Board of Examiners of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology
board.quote: The Wyoming Legislature created the Board of Examiners of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology in 1975 to protect the welfare of the public

education.value: Speech-language pathologists must hold at least a master's degree or its equivalent in speech-language pathology from an educational institution recognized by the board.
education.quote: Master's degree or its equivalent in the area of speech-language pathology from an educational institution recognized by the board

national_exam.value: Applicants must have their Praxis scores sent directly from PRAXIS to the Wyoming board office; the board will not accept scores from the applicant.
national_exam.quote: Contact PRAXIS and request for your scores to be sent to the Wyoming Board office on your behalf.

background_check.value: Applicants must submit 2 FD-258 fingerprint cards for a criminal history background check, with fingerprints taken within six months of submission to the board.
background_check.quote: Include 2 copies of the FD-258 fingerprint card in compliance with the separate instructions.

application_fee.value: The application fee is $300 per license type, non-refundable and payable to the State of Wyoming.
application_fee.quote: The application fee of $300.00 (per license type) in the form of a personal/business check

endorsement.value: SLPs actively licensed in another jurisdiction apply by endorsement, with official verification sent directly from every jurisdiction where they have been licensed or certified in the past 10 years, plus ASHA certification or transcripts.
endorsement.quote: Request an Official Verification be sent directly to the Wyoming Board Office from any jurisdiction where you currently or have been previously licensed or certified for the past 10 years.

temporary_or_provisional.value: Applicants who have not completed their clinical fellowship apply for a provisional license ($200 fee) and must file a supervision agreement with a Wyoming-licensed supervisor.
temporary_or_provisional.quote: With your State of Wyoming licensed supervisor, complete the supervision agreement form and submit it to the Board office.

renewal.value: SLP licenses expire on December 31 and renew for one calendar year; the renewal application must be postmarked by December 31, and there is no grace period.
renewal.quote: The renewal application must be post-marked by December 31st to be considered.

continuing_education.value: Licensees must complete 10 continuing education units (10 contact hours) of acceptable continuing education every year as a condition of renewal.
continuing_education.quote: must complete 10 Continuing Education Units (10 contact hours) of acceptable continuing education every year as a condition of renewal.

compact.value: The ASLP-IC lists Wyoming as not yet accepting applications for compact privileges to practice, so privileges are not yet issued for Wyoming.
compact.quote: Wyoming not yet not required WY Practice Act and

processing_time.value: Board review generally takes 2-3 weeks, in addition to 3-5 weeks for the background check to be returned.
processing_time.quote: Review generally takes 2-3 weeks in addition to the 3-5 weeks for the background check to be returned to the office.

apply_url.value: SLP application packets (provisional, endorsement, initial licensure and others) are posted on the board's Applications & Forms page to open, then download or print and fill out.
apply_url.quote: Click on the links below to open the form and then download or print the form from the file menu to fill the document out.
